runs: exact recorded actor and native query-selection replay
resourceObservation: Disabled for this targeted V8/query-tape storage regression. Canonical per-action/daily/final invariants remain; this is not all-resource or matrix qualification.
workerScope: Every configured original local worker callback, real PostgreSQL and canonical seasonal durations; no deadline shortening or skipped work.

guardrails.checks: Wall time after each callback; storage hourly, daily and final. Existing60-second callback deadline retained. Breach meansFAIL/incomplete with retained diagnostics and cleanup, never pass/skip.
guardrails.overshoot: A current callback or single artifact may exceed the last checked limit. Final diagnostics/verification/cleanup remain necessary after the limit.

retention: All canonical fields, raw snapshots, daily/final diagnostics, exact policy/RNG tapes, original worker transformations/jobs/schedule, initial/final dumps and complete artifact hash index. V3 native selection tape uses lossless bounded chunks.

priorFailure.otherInvalidation: Old shared-database world overlapped worker proof and was not isolated from database-scoped advisory locks. New runs use separate owned databases.
